proposals.evidence: DEDR1184 gives Kannada kaṇṇi rope/cord/neckrope and related Kota kayṇ. Survey Kannada kaŋŋɨ and Alu Kurumba kāŋŋī rope preserve their velar nasal transcription and compare with the documented rope noun; no eye-body-part analysis is substituted. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1120 gives Tamil kaṭalai, Malayalam kaṭala, Kannada kaḍale and related southern gram names. The survey kadala/kadale groundnut responses are a modern extension of that pulse noun; preserve groundnut rather than relabelling the referent Bengal gram. Homepage comparison also attests Kannada kaḍalekāyi groundnut under this family, but no ancient Dravidian word for the introduced crop is claimed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Survey Nilgiri/southern cinnā/śinnā/sīnnā/sinum forms retain this specific gold noun, including Kota final nasal expansion; no connection to the homonymous small adjective is proposed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2896 attests Tamil/Malayalam cōḷam, Kannada/Kodagu/Tulu jōḷa, Telugu/Gondi jonna/jona and Gadaba jonnēl for great millet/jowar/maize. Survey forms retain the southern lateral versus central nasal branches, with Muthuvan -kam/-ku expansion. The source generic millet gloss is preserved; DEDR’s comparison with similar IA words (CDIAL10434) remains an origin/contact caveat, not an asserted loan route. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
